mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we are looking at 73 degrees with a feels like temperature of 80 degrees under overcast skies near City Hall, all under a waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Senior Center is currently seeking volunteers to assist with their programs. Applicants should be prepared to commit to at least two shifts per month, and please note that some roles involve physical tasks. You can find the application form on the city website or at the front desk.

There is plenty to do, including live music at Bailey's Run today and at the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Also, the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a Girls Try Hockey event today. Tomorrow, you can check out the User Group Meeting at Epic Systems or catch a yoga class at Insight Wellness.
In police news, officers assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office on August 8 by deploying a drone to locate a burglary suspect who fled into a field after a vehicle pursuit.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. Please note the store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup.
